purpose: Correction: the hosted GovKit Storybook does exist; an earlier check probed the wrong host

supersedes.claim: https://aragon.github.io/gov-ui-kit/ returns GitHub Pages Site not found and index.json is HTTP 404
supersedes.status: true for that URL, but it is not the hosted Storybook, so the inference of no hosted Storybook was wrong

conclusion: Machine-readable discovery already exists statically today: index.json enumerates every story with id, title and importPath, served from a CDN with no running process. MCP is not required for discovery; it would add live tool calls and require a permanently running storybook dev server.
